```
The controller\textquotesingle s power dissipation can be modeled by:

\begin{equation}\label{eq:power}
  P_{\text{total}} = P_{\text{static}} + P_{\text{dynamic}}
\end{equation}

The maximum bandwidth depends on lane width and data rate:

\begin{equation}\label{eq:bw}
  \text{BW} = N_{\text{lanes}} \times \text{Data\_Rate} \times \text{Encoding\_Efficiency}
\end{equation}

\section{Style Examples}\label{sec:examples}

This section demonstrates all available document styles.

\subsection{Heading Level 4 (Paragraph)}

\paragraph{Register Access Protocol}
The register access protocol defines the transaction handshake between the application and the configuration space.

\subparagraph{Write Sequence}
The write sequence consists of three phases: address, data, and response.

\subsection{Note Style}

\begin{note}
  The PIPE interface must be initialized before any data transfer.
  Refer to the initialization sequence in Section~\ref{sec:func} on page~\pageref{sec:func}.
\end{note}

\begin{note}[Important]
  Operating beyond the rated electrical limits may cause permanent damage.
  See Table~\ref{tab:elec} for the complete specifications.
\end{note}

\subsection{Procedure (Numbered Steps)}

\begin{procedure}
  \item Configure PLL settings.
  \item Set lane width in the configuration register.
  \begin{procedure}
    \item For x1: set register 0x04[2:0] to 3\textquotesingle b001.
    \item For x4: set register 0x04[2:0] to 3\textquotesingle b100.
  \end{procedure}
  \item Enable LTSSM and wait for link-up.
\end{procedure}

\subsection{Unordered List (Bullets)}

\begin{bullets}

    \end{bullets}

  \item Ensure proper clock source.
```

**悬挂缩进 (Hanging indent):** The first line of a paragraph (which contains the number/bullet) starts at the left margin, while the rest of the paragraph (and continuation lines) are indented. In the context of numbered/bulleted lists, the number/bullet "hangs" to the left of the text. The hanging indent value is the distance from the left margin to where the text starts.

**左侧缩进 (Left indent):** The entire paragraph (including the number/bullet) is shifted to the right by the specified amount.

```
% ===========================================================================
%  INNOSILICON TECHNICAL DOCUMENT LATEX TEMPLATE
%  A comprehensive, ready-to-use template for technical databooks & manuals
%
%  HOW TO USE:
%  1. Set your document parameters in the "TEMPLATE VARIABLES" section below
%  2. Place your company logo as \<LogoFile> in this directory (or remove
%     the \IfFileExists line to use placeholder)
%  3. Compile: xelatex template.tex  (run 3 times for cross-references)
%
%  REQUIREMENTS:
%    - TeX Live 2023+ or MiKTeX with XeLaTeX
%    - Fonts: Times New Roman + Arial (supplied with Windows/macOS)
%    - C:/Windows/Fonts/wingding.ttf (for bullet symbols, Windows only)
% ===========================================================================

\documentclass[letterpaper, 12pt]{article}

% ======================== TEMPLATE VARIABLES ================================
%  EDIT THESE VALUES to customize the document.
%  Use \renewcommand for any variable you need to change after the preamble.
% ===========================================================================

% --- Company / Document Identity -------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\CompanyName}{INNOSILICON}
\newcommand{\CompanyNameShort}{INNOSILICON}
\newcommand{\DocTitle}{PCI Express Controller Databook}
\newcommand{\DocSubtitle}{Databook}
\newcommand{\DocVersion}{1.0}
\newcommand{\DocYear}{2026}
\newcommand{\DocWatermark}{DRAFT}          % "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL", or ""
\newcommand{\LogoFile}{innosilicon.png}     % logo image path

% --- Primary Colors (RGB) --------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorR}{0}
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorG}{112}
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorB}{192}
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorBgR}{189}
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorBgG}{214}
\newcommand{\PrimaryColorBgB}{238}

% --- Copyright Holder ------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\CopyrightHolder}{\CompanyName}
\newcommand{\CopyrightNotice}{All rights reserved.}

% --- Page Geometry ---------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\PageMargin}{2cm}
\newcommand{\HeadHeight}{20pt}
\newcommand{\HeadSep}{0.61cm}
\newcommand{\FootSkip}{1.1cm}
\newcommand{\PaperSize}{letterpaper}       % letterpaper or a4paper

% ===========================================================================
%  END OF TEMPLATE VARIABLES  —  Do not edit below unless you know LaTeX.
% ===========================================================================

% ======================== Packages ========================
\usepackage[\PaperSize, margin=\PageMargin, headheight=\HeadHeight,
            headsep=\HeadSep, footskip=\FootSkip]{geometry}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{atbegshi}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{placeins}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{setspace}
\usepackage{amsmath}

% ======================== Colors ========================
\definecolor{primarycolor}{RGB}{\PrimaryColorR,\PrimaryColorG,\PrimaryColorB}
\definecolor{primarycolorbg}{RGB}{\PrimaryColorBgR,\PrimaryColorBgG,\PrimaryColorBgB}
\colorlet{innoblue}{primarycolor}
\colorlet{innobluebg}{primarycolorbg}

% ======================== Fonts ========================
\setmainfont{Times New Roman}
\setsansfont{Arial}
\newfontfamily\headingfont{Arial}[BoldFont={Arial}, ItalicFont={Arial Italic}]

% ======================== Body Text ========================
\onehalfspacing
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{12pt}
\raggedright

% ======================== Watermark ========================
\newcommand{\watermarktext}{\DocWatermark}
\newcommand{\watermarkcolor}{primarycolor}
\newcommand{\watermarkangle}{45}

\newif\iffirstpage
\firstpagetrue

\AtBeginShipout{%
  \iffirstpage
    \global\firstpagefalse
  \else
    \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture, overlay]
      \node[rotate=\watermarkangle,
            font=\fontsize{60}{60}\selectfont,
            text=\watermarkcolor,
            opacity=0.15]
        at (current page.center) {\watermarktext};
    \end{tikzpicture}%
  \fi
}

% ======================== Logo ========================
\newcommand{\logoimage}{%
```

```
================================================================================
  DATABOOK LATEX TEMPLATE — 格式规格说明书
================================================================================
  最终样式总表（基于 2026-06-10 对话确认）
================================================================================


一、页面布局
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  纸张大小      Letter (21.59cm x 27.94cm)
  页边距(四边)  2cm
  页眉字顶端距纸边  1.1cm  (headheight=15pt, headsep=19pt, no includehead)
  页脚距纸边        1.1cm  (footskip=0.9cm, no includefoot)
  正文顶端空白      无     (topskip=0pt)


二、字体
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  正文        Times New Roman, 12pt
  无衬线标题  Arial (sffamily)
  页眉右侧    5号 (10.5pt), Arial, 蓝色
  页脚左侧    小四 (12pt), Times New Roman, 黑色
  页脚右侧    小四 (12pt), Times New Roman, 页码

  \zihao 字号映射:
    \zihao{0} = 初号 42pt
    \zihao{2} = 二号 22pt
    \zihao{3} = 三号 16pt


三、颜色
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  primarycolor   = RGB(  0, 112, 192)  — 蓝色 (标题/页眉/水印/表格线/bullet)
  primarycolorbg = RGB(189, 214, 238)  — 浅蓝 (表格表头底色)


四、封面 (Title Page)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  第一行:  DATABOOK, Arial 二号(22pt), 黑色, 粗体, 左对齐
  第二行:  蓝色横线 (primarycolor, 0.5pt)
  第三行:  Logo (logo/innosilicon2.png), \textwidth 宽度, 居中
  中央:    IP Name, Arial 初号(42pt), 黑色, 居中

  底部三行 (Arial 三号 16pt, 居中, 1.5倍行距):
    Process: Process Node   (Process 加粗)
    Version: 1.0            (Version 加粗)
    June 2026

  封面无页眉页脚 (\thispagestyle{firstpage})
  封面无水印 (自动跳过)


五、前置章节 (Front Matter)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  页码: 罗马数字 (i, ii, iii...)

  版权声明 (Copyright Notice):
    标题居中 \Large, 正文左对齐, 有页眉页脚 (\thispagestyle{fancy})

  Revision History / Terms and Acronyms / TOC / LOF / LOT:
    标题使用 \prefacesection{...} 样式:
      - Arial 24pt, 蓝色(primarycolor), 左对齐
      - 单倍行距, 段后 12pt


六、正文标题 (Headings)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Section (H1):
    字号 26pt, 蓝色, 行距 1.0, 段前 0pt 段后 18pt
    编号: 蓝底白字盒子 (headnumber)
    盒子 4.46cm x 3.48cm, Arial 80pt, 白字, 右对齐

  Subsection (H2):
    字号 22pt, 蓝色, 行距 1.5
    编号缩进 1.02cm, 段前 18pt 段后 12pt

  Subsubsection (H3):
    字号 20pt, 黑色, 行距 1.5
    编号缩进 1.27cm, 段前 18pt 段后 12pt

  Paragraph (H4):
    字号 18pt, 黑色, 行距 1.5
    编号缩进 1.52cm, 段前 18pt 段后 12pt

  Subparagraph (H5):
    字号 16pt, 黑色, 行距 1.5
    编号缩进 1.78cm, 段前 18pt 段后 12pt


七、正文段落
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  行距: 1.5 倍 (\onehalfspacing)
  段首缩进: 0pt
  段间距: 12pt
  对齐: 左对齐 (\raggedright)


八、表格
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  标题: 加粗居中, 1.5 倍行距
  表头行: 蓝色底色 (primarycolorbg), 左对齐加粗
  表格线: 全框线, 顶线 0.75pt
  行高: \extrarowheight=4pt

  \tableheader 命令: 蓝色底色 + 加粗左对齐


九、图题注
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  加粗居中, 1.5 倍行距
  段前 0pt, 段后 1\baselineskip


十、Note 环境
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  标题: 加粗斜体, 12pt, 1.5 倍行距
  正文: 斜体, 12pt, 1.5 倍行距
  段前 1\baselineskip, 段后 6pt


十一、公式
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  \abovedisplayskip    = 0pt
  \belowdisplayskip    = 12pt
  \abovedisplayshortskip  = 0pt
  \belowdisplayshortskip  = 12pt


十二、Procedure 列表
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  层级 1: 编号 1. 2. 3., 左缩进 1.5cm, labelsep 0.3cm
  层级 2: 编号 a) b) c., 左缩进 0.74cm, labelsep 0.2cm
  行距 1.5, itemsep 6pt, topsep 6pt


十三、Bullets 无序列表
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  符号: Wingdings 字体, 蓝色 (primarycolor)

  层级 1: 符号字符118 → \XeTeXglyph153, 左缩进 0.74cm
  层级 2: 符号字符108 → \XeTeXglyph122, 左缩进 0.74cm
  层级 3: 符号字符250 → \XeTeXglyph224, 左缩进 1.48cm

  行距 1.5, itemsep 6pt, topsep 6pt


十四、交叉引用
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  \ref / \pageref: 蓝色斜体 (linkcolor=primarycolor)
  hyperref: colorlinks=true, linkcolor=primarycolor


十五、水印
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  文字: DRAFT (可通过 \DocWatermark 修改)
  颜色: 蓝色 (primarycolor)
  旋转: 45°
  不透明度: 15%
  字号: 36pt
  范围: 除首页外所有页面


十六、代码块 (listings)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  框线: 单线, 蓝色 (rulecolor=primarycolor), 0.4pt
  行号: 左侧, 灰色小字
  字号: 9pt


十七、附录
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  样式: 与一级标题相同 (headnumber + Arial 26pt 蓝色)
  编号: A, B, C... (\appendix 自动转换)
  页码: 延续正文 (继续阿拉伯数字, 不重置)


十八、页眉页脚
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  页眉左: Logo (logo/innosilicon.png, 3cm x 0.32cm)
  页眉右: 文档标题, Arial 10.5pt, 蓝色
  页眉线: 无 (0pt)

  页脚左: 版权声明, TNR 12pt
  页脚右: 页码, TNR 12pt
  页脚线: 蓝色 (primarycolor), 0.4pt


================================================================================
  编译: xelatex databook.tex (运行 3 次)
================================================================================

```
